title: publish executor
description: Publishes a package to npm via OIDC, pushes the version bump + tag to main, and creates a GitHub Release with auto-generated changelog. Idempotent.

packageName.description: npm package name to publish. Default: derived from package.json name.

packagePath.description: Path to the package directory containing package.json. Default: the project root.

version.description: Version to release (x.y.z, or patch|minor|major vs npm latest). Default: patch.

dryRun.description: If true, do not publish, tag, push, or create a release. Default: false.

branch.description: Branch to push the bump commit to. Default: main.

generateNotes.description: If true, create a GitHub Release with auto-generated changelog. Default: true.

provenance.description: If true, publish with --provenance (npm OIDC). Default: true.
